observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor or semi-outdoor venue at night with patterned carpet flooring, string lights, and an audience of men seated and standing around the performance space
observation.dancers: one female soloist initially, later joined by male guests in the performance space
observation.formation_and_space: soloist dancing centrally while audience forms a circle around her, moving across the floor and spinning
observation.posture: upright torso, relaxed knees, weight shifting between feet
observation.footwork: stepping side to side, turning, tapping, and pivoting in place to the beat; exact foot mechanics partially obscured by long skirt
observation.arms_and_hands: arms moving fluidly overhead, framing the face, gesturing outward, holding or tossing currency notes
observation.hips_and_torso: subtle hip movements, waist articulation, and expressive torso undulations
observation.partnering: none with the main soloist, though male audience members occasionally dance nearby or join the space informally
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent spinning turns, occasional crouching or dipping down to the floor and rising back up
observation.costume_and_props: female dancer wears a black sheer long-sleeved top, matching skirt, and dupatta; men wear traditional shalwar kameez and shawls; paper currency notes are tossed as props
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement and rapid footwork details are obscured by the long skirt and carpet texture

signature_moments.what: female dancer spins in place with arms gracefully raised overhead, hair flowing
dancer crouches low towards the carpet while waving her hands and hair in a dramatic flourish
rhythmic foot tapping and hip sway while gesturing with arms framing the face
rapid multiple continuous turns as audience members shower currency notes over her
expressive shoulder and arm gestures while stepping in a circle amidst falling money
